field_principles.band_tuned_on_calibration: Methodology - band tuned on calibration, evaluated held-out; no leakage.
field_principles.cascade_auroc: Accuracy of the classifier-first cascade - should approach pure-LLM AUROC.
field_principles.cascade_cost_ratio: BARE FLOAT - pure_llm_cost / cascade_cost; the deployable 'Nx cheaper at matched accuracy' number.
field_principles.escalation_fraction: Fraction of items escalated to the LLM - the cost driver; low => big savings.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Methodology - aggregation substrate; reuses exp3917 per-item LLM scores so no double-inference.
field_principles.n_calibration: Methodology - calibration split size used only for band tuning.
field_principles.n_heldout: Methodology - heldout split size used for reported metrics.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Methodology - cached Exp 3917 score and cost evidence checked before aggregation.
field_principles.pure_llm_auroc: The pure-LLM-judge baseline the cascade must (near-)match.
field_principles.random_seed: Methodology - deterministic split and reproducibility seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Methodology - hash over upstream artifact, split, tuned band, costs, and heldout scores.
